info.name: Armor CRM — CP Edit Order Item (#270)
info.description:
NEW API only. Existing collection armor_crm_api_collection.postman.json is unchanged.

#266 = Add item (new line).
#270 = Edit existing line (qty / rate / discount).
#268 = Delete item.

Endpoint: POST service/service_channel_partner.php
key=1226

**App flow:**
1) #256 get_cp_customer_order_detail → items[].item_id, items[].rate (GROSS original), items[].discount
2) User edits qty / discount / rate on that line
3) #270 with order_id + item_id + qty + discount. rate optional (leave empty to keep original product rate)
4) Response result = updated order detail (same as #256)

**Rate rule (same as cart #251):**
rate = GROSS before discount. Do NOT send discounted net / unitprice.
Discount-only change keeps original_price.
Example: Rate 9300, Disc 10 → net 8370. Edit Disc 20 → Rate still 9300, net 7440.

Pending orders only (can_edit=1).
Live: https://crm.mahadevcasting.in
Local: http://localhost:8080/armor_crm_08_07/202526

formdata.description: Required if changing qty. Must be > 0
Optional GROSS rate (before discount). Leave empty to keep original product rate
Disc %. Rate stays original — do not send net as rate

request.description:
Edit one existing product line on Pending CP customer order.

Required: key, s=270, channel_partner_id, order_id, item_id
Optional: qty, rate (GROSS), discount

Response: ack, item_id, qty, rate, original_price, discount, sub_total, gst_amount, grand_total, result (full #256 detail).
Stock: only qty difference is debited/credited if order already stock-debited.

Add new line → still use #266.
Delete line → #268.
